root_canonical_objects_correction.issue: The independent JavaScript auditor initially compared JSON objects using insertion-order JSON.stringify. The result writer sorts object keys, so equal count records could be rejected only because of key order.
root_canonical_objects_correction.correction: Recursively canonicalize object keys for structural comparisons while preserving array order.
root_canonical_objects_correction.verification: Read ops9.save: it uses sort_keys=True. Revised root auditor passed JavaScript syntax construction. No saved result had yet been passed to either version.

centered_auditor_correction.issue: Uncentered logaddexp.reduce(logits) minus target can lose the normalizer contribution under an extreme common logit offset.
centered_auditor_correction.correction: Center float64 rows by their maxima before the independent logaddexp reduction and target subtraction.
centered_auditor_correction.verification: Root exact textual comparison established one added centering line. Inputs, selected conditions, formulas, tolerances and output schema unchanged.
